events.title: OpenAI GPT-5 released
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 on August 7, 2025 — a unified system that routes between fast responses and extended reasoning, replacing GPT-4o and o3 in ChatGPT.
events.about: GPT-5 merged OpenAI's chat and reasoning lines into one default model: stronger coding, math, health, and vision with automatic thinking when needed. GPT-5 Pro added scaled test-time compute for the hardest tasks — resetting the consumer AI baseline the way GPT-4 did in 2023.

narrative.whyChosen: GPT-5 unified OpenAI's fragmented model picker into one flagship system.
narrative.whyImportant: Automatic reasoning routing made frontier intelligence the default, not a power-user toggle.
narrative.problemSolved: Users faced confusing choices between GPT-4.x, o-series, and API-only models.
